newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees A$10-15 mln savings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees A$10-15 mln savings.

text.p: RTZ-CRA said on Wednesday the cost of its global restructuring within Australia would be about A$10-15 million but this would be offset by savings from the move.
"In terms of the costs in Australia, we are talking about in the order of A$10-15 million," CRA managing director Leigh Clifford told a news conference.
"Obviously, when you look at savings there is enough savings which we believe will be higher than that," Clifford said.
"Obviously we have made changes in Johannesburg and Salt Lake City which are not included in what I just said," he said.

The dual-listed Anglo-Australian mining giant announced earlier on Wednesday it would restructure its management into six new global product businesses, with copper, gold and other minerals, and industrial minerals divisions based in London and aluminium, energy and iron ore divisions based in Australia.
Clifford said about 100 jobs would be lost in Melbourne as a result of the substantial restructuring of the Melbourne office and the change in its role to one of support.
